name: Microsoft co-sell
short_description: Co-sell is Microsoft's partner motion in which eligible partner solutions are made visible to and recommended by Microsoft's sales teams and other partners, managed through Partner Center.

evidence.quote: Then there's co-sell. This is probably the most powerful feature that most people don't know about.
from listing optimization to co-cell to deal acceleration.
Microsoft's CoSEL program lets their own sales team recommend partner solutions to customers.
Coastal readiness is a separate process from listing. It's not automatic.
still wake up six months from now wondering why your co-sell pipeline dried up
Co-SEL isn't a bonus feature. It's the default way Microsoft sells.
Co-sell is a two-way motion. You bring opportunities to Microsoft.
